children: FTC's proposed order requires the company to stop making deceptive claims and pay a monetary judgment

The Federal Trade Commission is taking action against Elk River Inc., an Alabama-based manufacturer of safety harnesses and other fall protection equipment for workers, for falsely claiming that its harnesses are "Made in USA."
